name: Poprings Masala flavour
ingredients_raw: CORN MEAL (68%), EDIBLE VEGETABLE OIL (PALMOLEIN, RICE BRAN), SUGAR, EDIBLE COMMON SALT, SPICES & CONDIMENTS 1% (CUMIN, CHILLI, DRY MANGO), MALTODEXTRIN, DEHYDRATED VEGETABLE POWDER (ONION, GARLIC), STABILIZER (INS 170 (1), ACIDITY REGULATOR (INS 330, INS 340), EMULSIFIER (INS 471, INS 414), ANTICAKING AGENT (INS 551), FLAVOUR ENHANCER (INS 627, INS 631), NATURAL & NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (CHILLI, DRY MANGO), HYDROLYZED VEGETABLE PROTEIN (SOYA), PAPRIKA EXTRACT (INS 160C). PROPRIETARY FOOD NAMKEEN INDIAN SNACKS & SAVOURIES ALLERGEN ADVICE: CONTAINS SOY.
